title.zh: India’s tokenized bond pilot starts with institutions, with retail access planned next
title.en: India’s tokenized bond pilot starts with institutions, with retail access planned next

current_state.zh: SEBI launched the Demat 2.0 pilot, settling ₹1,025 crore in tokenized corporate bonds from REC, L&T, and IIFL on linked digital rails with atomic delivery-versus-payment, while planning secondary trading and retail access in Stage II.
current_state.en: SEBI launched the Demat 2.0 pilot, settling ₹1,025 crore in tokenized corporate bonds from REC, L&T, and IIFL on linked digital rails with atomic delivery-versus-payment, while planning secondary trading and retail access in Stage II.
